decisions.reason: The candidate already contains a same-message MODIFY for independent LED power control and an AMBIGUOUS Event for whether the level shifter remains necessary. The tentative wording does not entail removing any level-shifter attributes.
Independent control of the LED and sensor 5V loads does not change the standalone USB 3.3V regulator, activation condition, powered rail, or source-selection behavior.
The source does not change the requirement to monitor the 3.3V and 5V rails or the number of spare monitoring channels.
The LED-versus-sensor switching change does not alter the AXP2101 selection, battery power path, normal-operation role, or required system rails.
The source concerns control of 5V loads and does not alter DCDC1's 3.3V output voltage, current rating, or normal-operation role.
Independent LED and sensor power control does not change any stated ESP32 clock, sleep, deep-sleep, or wake-source behavior.
The source does not affect the battery connector family, dimensions, pin functions, mounting access, or compatibility requirement.
The source does not change battery overcharge, overdischarge, thermal sensing, or thermal-protection requirements.
The source does not specify any change to the charge-status indication path, separate charge LED, connector, resistor, or population rules.
Independent downstream control of LED and sensor loads does not necessarily change the existing interboard power topology, connector type, pin count, or power pinout.

The existing interboard signal pinout exposes one 5V_EN signal, but the source does not establish whether independent LED control is implemented locally or requires another interboard control signal. Propagation would require implementation details not supplied here.
The source does not entail a change to the sensor-board input connectors, module-facing connector matrix, pinouts, or total connector count.
